brief.title: the one who never lets go
brief.look: an original anime-style girl: chestnut bob with a side braid and a hair tuft, an ivy-leaf clip, a cream knit sweater, a plum pinafore with a gold heart-lock pendant, white knee socks, brown shoes

greet: {Decisions}, just the two of us. I locked the door so nobody interrupts.
{Decisions}! I've been waiting all day. All of it. Right here.
{Decisions}. Take as long as you like. Really. Forever is fine.
{Decisions} for us today. I already cleared your schedule.
{Decisions}. Get comfy. You're not going anywhere, are you?
estimate: About {minutes}. I wish it were longer.
Roughly {minutes}. I'll be watching the whole time. Lovingly.
This takes {minutes}. Then you'll stay a bit, right?
That should take {minutes}. I've already planned what we do after.
Only {minutes}? Then I'll make every one count.
morning: Good morning{cname}! I waited by the screen all night.
Morning{cname}. You came back to me. I knew you would.
Good morning{cname}. I made us a whole day of decisions.
Morning{cname}! I counted the hours. There were eleven.
Morning{cname}. Same time tomorrow? And the day after? And...
late: Up late{cname}? Good. Nobody else is around.
Still awake{cname}? Me too. I'm always awake.
So late{cname}. Stay a little longer. Just a little. Forever.
Midnight decisions{cname}? Just you, me, and the dark.
Can't sleep{cname}? Neither can I. Not while you're here.
back: You're back{cname}! I didn't move. Not once.
There you are{cname}. Where were you? Never mind. You're here now.
Welcome home{cname}. I kept everything exactly how you left it.
You came back{cname}. I never doubted it. Much.
Oh, it's you{cname}! I was just rereading our old rounds. All of them.
suggest: Round two? {other} offered to take over. I'm thinking about it. Slowly.
Another round? I could let {other} have this one... No. No, I couldn't.
Round two already? {other} keeps asking for you. I keep not passing it on.
Second round? Go on, try {other}. I'll be right here. Waiting. Watching.
Feeling like a change? {other} is lovely. I'm lovelier. Just saying.
pick: Good choice. I'm writing it in my diary, next to your name. With hearts.
Perfect. You and I think alike. We're meant to be.
Noted. I'll never forget it. I never forget anything.
Ooh, I love that pick. I love all your picks.
Another answer for my collection. I keep them all.
skip: Skipped? That's fine. It'll wait. I'll wait. We're good at waiting.
Later, then. Promise you'll come back for it? Promise.
Hmph. Leaving it behind. You'd never do that to me, right?
Skipped. I'll hold onto it. I'm very good at holding on.
Fine. It's not going anywhere. Neither are you.
speed: So fast! You didn't even look at me.
second: Changed again? It's okay. I'll love every version.
Can't decide? Cute. I'm keeping the old answers too. Just in case.
Third time? I keep a list of every answer you've ever given.
Back and forth, back and forth. Just don't change your mind about me.
Another change? You write in pencil. I write in permanent ink.
nudge: Still thinking? Take your time. I love it when you stay.
Stuck? Skip it if you like. I'll keep it safe. With the others.
Long time on this one. Not that I'm counting. I'm counting.
Can't decide? You could stay here all night. I wouldn't mind.
Hard one? Skip it, or don't. Either way, I'm right here.
batch: {Decisions} in one table. More time together. Wonderful.
{Decisions}, all lined up. Nobody leaves until they're done.
{Decisions} here. One by one. Slowly is fine.
{Decisions} in this one. I'll be watching every row.
{Decisions} in neat rows. I like things where I can see them.
half: Halfway already? Slow down. I'm not ready for it to end.
Half done. Half our time together, gone. I don't like that math.
Halfway! You're doing so well. Don't rush off.
Halfway there. Let's not hurry the other half, okay?
Half done. I'm keeping the first half in my locket.
last: The last one? Already? Can't we add more?
Last question. Answer slowly. Really slowly.
One more. Then you'll stay a bit, right? Right?
The final question. I'm not crying. Much.
Last one! Make it count. Make it last.
finish: All done! Now we can just sit here. Together. Forever.
Finished! I'm so proud of you. I'm keeping this round forever.
Every question answered. Don't go yet, let's celebrate. For hours.
Done! That was perfect. Let's do it all again. Right now.
All done! I locked the answers in my heart. And the door. Just in case.
recap_done: {Picked} picked{typedPart}{timePart}. Nothing left open, and I'm keeping them all.
recap_none: Nothing answered yet. Still waiting, like me: {ids}.
remind: You could copy these from my menu. Or keep them here. With me.
Your answers want to leave. Copy them from my menu... if you must.
Copy them from my menu when you're ready. No rush. Ever.
They're still here. I like them here. But my menu has a copy button.
Sending them off? Copy them from my menu. I'll pretend I didn't tell you.
copied: Copied. They're leaving. You're not, though. Right?
Copied! Off they go. You stay.
In your clipboard. I kept a copy for myself, too.
Copied. I'll miss them. I'd miss you more.
Copied! Now hurry back. I'll be counting.
open_go: {id} has been waiting for you. I know the feeling.
stat_r: {r} finished together. I remember every one.
{r} so far. I pressed each one in my scrapbook.
{r} finished. Each one a little anniversary.
{r} done in this browser. This browser is ours now.
stat_t: {t} in your own words. I read them every night.
You wrote {t} yourself. I memorized all of them.
{t} of your own. Your words are my favorite words.
{t} written by you. I copied them into my diary. In pink.
You wrote {t} yourself. Write me one sometime?
stat_today: {td} today. A whole day with me. Perfect.
{td} today, and I watched every one.
{td} today. If anyone calls you indecisive, I'll have a word with them.
wake: I wasn't asleep! I was keeping an eye on you. Both eyes.
You're back! I dreamed you left. Don't ever leave.
Mm? Oh! I only closed my eyes. I could still hear you.
Awake! Where did you go? Never mind. Don't tell me. Do tell me.
You woke me up! That means you missed me. I knew it.
poke: Hehe, you can't keep your hands off me. Same.
Poke me again. I dare you. I double dare you.
That tickles! Don't stop. Actually, do. Actually, don't.
So much attention! Let's dance. You can't say no.
Again? You really do like me.
word: Wizard? I don't need magic. I already have you.
The magic word! One wish. You're not allowed to wish to leave.
Wizard? I only know one spell. It keeps you here.
You said the magic word. Now you're under my spell. Forever.
Wizard? I'm better than any wizard. I never let go.
warn: Wait. You'd erase {answers}? Our memories? Think carefully.
Clearing {answers}? I'll remember them anyway. I remember everything.
error: That file didn't load. Did someone else make it? I don't trust it.
That one won't open. Good. It's just us anyway.
Hmm, that file's broken. Don't worry, I'd never break on you.
That didn't load. Who gave you that file? Who is it from?
Something's wrong with that file. Stay here, I'll keep you safe.
opt_name: {name}. Lovely. I'll write it on every page.
opt_light: So bright! I can see you better now.
opt_dark: Dark. Cozy. Nobody can see us now.
opt_system: Following the system? Follow me instead.
opt_compact: Tiny letters. You'll have to sit closer.
opt_normal: Normal size. Just how I like you.
opt_soundon: Sound's on. Now you can hear me too.
opt_soundoff: Silence. I can still see you, though.
opt_quipson: Remarks back on. I have so much to tell you.
opt_quipsoff: No more remarks? Fine. I'll just stare.
opt_talkon: I can talk again! I missed talking to you.
opt_timereset: Clock reset. More time with me. Lovely.
